papers.title: Two-Stage Cementless Revision Total Hip Arthroplasty for Infected Primary Hip Arthroplasties

corresponding_authors.name: Hakan Sofu
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Erzincan University Faculty of Medicine, Erzincan, Turkey

llm.relevance_to_user: 这篇论文是完全临床的，没有涉及任何生物力学建模或有限元分析。
llm.why_not_core: This paper reports clinical outcomes of revision arthroplasty for infection, without any biomechanical modeling, stress shielding analysis, micromotion quantification, or contact mechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估两阶段非骨水泥翻修术治疗感染的效果
summary_zh.method: 回顾性分析感染髋关节翻修患者的数据
summary_zh.result: 两阶段翻修术在控制感染和假体存活率方面效果良好

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the effectiveness of two-stage cementless revision for infected primary hip arthroplasties.
summary_en.method: A retrospective analysis of patients undergoing two-stage revision for periprosthetic joint infection.
summary_en.result: The two-stage revision demonstrated good infection control and implant survival at mid-term follow-up.
summary_en.validation: Clinical follow-up data from a cohort of patients.

papers.title: Fabrication of cell-laden electrospun hybrid scaffolds of alginate-based bioink and PCL microstructures for tissue regeneration
papers.first_author_affiliation: Department of Biomechatronic Engineering, College of Biotechnology and Bioengineering, Sungkyunkwan University (SKKU), Suwon, South Korea

corresponding_authors.name: GeunHyung Kim
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Biomechatronic Engineering, College of Biotechnology and Bioengineering, Sungkyunkwan University (SKKU), Suwon, South Korea

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文不涉及任何人工智能方法，因此与AI生物打印研究方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not integrate AI into any bioprinting workflow stage; it is purely a materials and fabrication study without computational modeling or machine learning.

summary_zh.motivation: 制备用于组织再生的复合支架
summary_zh.method: 使用海藻酸盐生物墨水和PCL微结构通过静电纺丝制备
summary_zh.result: 成功制造了细胞负载的混合支架
summary_zh.validation: 力学测试表征支架性能

summary_en.motivation: To fabricate hybrid scaffolds combining alginate-based bioink and PCL microstructures for enhanced tissue regeneration.
summary_en.method: Electrospinning was used to create cell-laden hybrid scaffolds with alginate bioink and PCL microstructures.
summary_en.result: The hybrid scaffolds were successfully fabricated and characterized for mechanical properties and cell compatibility.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing and cell viability assays were performed to validate scaffold properties.
